text:
Situation: Fludarabine phosphate has been on the FDA drug shortage list since 2022-05-06 and remains listed as of 2026-10-21, a period of 54 months. Current inventory varies across sites. Corvale East holds two presentations totaling 33 units with 4.1–4.4 days on hand. Corvale General holds two lots totaling 135.98 units with 12.4–18.3 days on hand. Corvale Lakeside holds 6 units with 6.3 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA posted the shortage on 2022-05-06. An inspection of NerPharMa S.r.l. (FEI 3004762406) ended 2020-01-17 and was classified VAI, with the classification letter dated 2021-05-19 — 840 days before the shortage posting. The same plant was inspected again on 2024-09-13 and classified VAI. A second label names ACTAVIS TOTOWA as the manufacturing plant, but no inspection record for that site is provided.

Our position: The shortage is longstanding and supply remains constrained at Corvale East. Corvale General has sufficient stock to support a limited transfer while maintaining two weeks of supply. Alternative manufacturers are not on the FDA shortage list today, but their manufacturing sites are not fully verified. Because links between labels and plants are weak or some records fail data checks, we must verify current manufacturing sites for each NDC before committing to purchases.

Recommended actions:
1. Verify current manufacturing sites for each NDC with the pharmacy director and confirm transfer feasibility.
2. Transfer 12 units from Corvale General to Corvale East — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).
3. Evaluate purchase from Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC — approved by buyer.
4. Evaluate purchase from Hisun Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc. — approved by buyer.
5. Evaluate purchase from Lannett Company, Inc. — approved by buyer.
6. Evaluate purchase from Sagent Pharmaceuticals — approved by buyer.

Not recommended: Initiate any purchase without confirmed manufacturing site verification; rely on unverified label-plant links for procurement decisions.
